newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates share rise gathers pace.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates share rise gathers pace.

text.p: Most shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market rose in the week to Thursday on higher trading volumes, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week over 19 points higher at 2,426.82 from 2,407.59 points.
A NBAD report said the increase was due to "the rise in the prices of 12 banks and listed companies as well as a noticeable rise in the volume of trade".
Shares of the new al-Khazna Insurance fell back to 245 dirhams from 300. The share had clocked up major gains since its issue in late September at 100 dirhams.
There was good demand for bank shares, brokers said.
Union National Bank shares were up by 10 dirhams at 370 after gaining 35 dirhams the previous week. NBAD was up at 420 dirhams from 415.
The market leader, telecommunications company Etisalat was steady at 950 while Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co shares rose 25 dirhams to 990 after a 10 dirham gain the previous week.
